entities.summary: Arshavir Shirakian was an Armenian writer and assassin who was noted for his assassination of Said Halim Pasha and Cemal Azmi as an act of vengeance for their roles in the Armenian genocide. His memoirs, It was the Will for the Martyrs, is a description of his life during the Armenian genocide and the Operation Nemesis.
